CustomField.description: Store a snapshot of the matching job on AsyncResult__c so Async.requeue() can replay it. A payload holds whatever data the job carried, so this is off unless you turn it on. Blank falls back to the All record; No on a job record overrides Yes on All, which is how you exclude a job that carries sensitive data. Turning this on also writes a result row for failed and skipped jobs even when Create Result is off, because a payload with no row is unreachable.
CustomField.label: Store Job Payload
